title: Naturality of constant sections over a strictly henselian local spectrum
statement: For a strictly henselian local ring R, the inverse of the canonical sheafification map from the constant presheaf to the constant etale sheaf, evaluated at the terminal etale object of Spec R, forms an additive natural isomorphism from the constant sheaf followed by evaluation to the identity functor on AddCommGrpCat.

source.place: Tags 03P5 and 05TD, naturality of constant sections and sheafification

proof.text: For each coefficient group use the inverse of the bijective sheafification unit at the terminal etale object. Naturality follows by applying the naturality equation for the sheafification unit to a coefficient homomorphism; the constant presheaf map is pointwise that homomorphism.

mathlib_searches.query: natural isomorphism from constant sheaf sections to coefficients
naturality of constant sheaf sections under coefficient homomorphism

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_strictlyHenselian_constant_sections_natural_iso
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing R] :
    Nonempty ((constantSheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ⋙
      (sheafToPresheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        (evaluation (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).Etaleᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (op (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Etale.mk
            (𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))))) ≅ 𝟭 AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
